title: Welcome Quanzhentong (全诊通) as a Unique Partner
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Unique Partner · May 10, 2024

Unique Partner Network (UPN) introduction:

About Quanzhentong

Hangzhou Quanzhen Medical Technology, founded Jan 2016 — AI + big data for healthcare. LLM-based Quanzhen AI Doctor Assistant: AI triage, AI pre-consult, AI in-clinic dictation, inpatient full-flow note auto-generation. “AI + EMR” users among China’s top tier — 9 provinces, 18 cities, 100+ counties; 15,000+ small/mid providers; 100+ county health bureaus for medical big-data monitoring.

CEO Xue Chong — Johns Hopkins postdoc, PUMC surgery PhD, ex-ZJU 2nd Affiliated Hospital surgeon. CSO Shen Jian — ex-Cisco/WebEx SVP, WeDoctor COO, 99Bill SVP, Daily Interactive / Getui co-founder/president; active angel. COO Kong Xiangqing — ex-Daily Interactive VP/supervisor. LLM architect Liu Rui — Alibaba 1688 / Wacai / Youzan data leadership. Advisor Zheng Xiaoqing — Fudan CS professor (text/speech ML/DL).

40+ patents/software copyrights; NHSC digital-health AI contest 2nd (precision medicine); Tech Sanya 2023 champion; national AI scenario challenge 2nd (growth medical); NHTE / Zhejiang tech SME / Hangzhou 5050 / Eagle Plan, etc.

Products

  1. AI triage — LLM differential-diagnosis questioning vs rigid multiple-choice; age/sex-aware department routing.
  2. AI pre-consult — clinician-style dialogue; photo OCR of outside records; draft notes synced to doctor workstation before room entry; acute/severe alerts to nurse fast track.
  3. AI in-clinic dictation — listen to doctor–patient talk → structured medical text in ~2s; one-tap into HIS; one-button record start.
  4. Inpatient full-flow notes — portable AI aide for admission/rounds/discussions; multimodal OCR; 1,000+ surgery-record templates from spoken postop summary.

Cases

Live in 20+ hospitals incl. Zhejiang Provincial People’s, ZJU Shao Yifu, Zhejiang Hospital, Dongzhimen (BUCM), ZJU 4th, Shaoxing People’s, Changzhou 1st, Heilongjiang TCM, Qingyang People’s + 10+ community hospitals.

Outpatient — Shao Yifu: first national full deployment of Quanzhen AI doctor assistant — pre-consult + live dictation notes + follow-up/revisit prompts.

Ward — Zhejiang Provincial People’s: full inpatient AI documentation + omission prompts; training data for residents/基层.

Partner imagery — attach on ingest (3 images).

— END —
